ambience_beds.acoustic_environment: Nocturnal East African Rift gorge; cold wind whistling through basalt overhangs with deep, low-frequency subterranean rumble from thousands of miles away.
Extreme volcanic convection storm; continuous roaring atmospheric draft feeding into a 32-kilometer ash column, punctuated by deep subsonic shock tremors.
Suffocating grey tephra blizzard; continuous soft hiss of falling silicate glass particles, howling monsoonal winds, and electrostatic hum in the sulfur-laden sky.
Arid, sunless Pleistocene freeze; bitter dry gale howling across cracked river terraces, rattling desiccated reed beds and dead thorn scrub.
Enclosed cave acoustic; intimate subterranean resonance, low wind buffeting the canyon entrance, and the gentle flickering hiss of burning wood coals.
Utter loneliness of the genetic bottleneck; massive, hollow open-air acoustic across hundreds of miles of ash desert with faint drifting dust.
Narrow rocky riverbed canyon; close rock reflection, sluggish water lapping against gravel bars, and occasional darting aquatic life.
Focused, intimate artisanal shelter; roaring warm campfire, soft leather rustle, and crisp high-frequency stone-flaking acoustic resonance.
Paralyzing tactical silence; quiet wind across the gravel bar, strained breathing of two armed clans, and the taut tension of the canyon.
Mighty Indian Ocean coastline; rhythmic thunder of breaker waves against quartzite cliffs, swirling mist, and booming cave mouth resonance.
Warming river valley; flowing water gaining momentum, crisp morning air warming in the sun, and the footsteps of a united clan walking north.
Universal, mythic acoustic space; gentle warm fire embers breathing in the foreground transitioning softly into an expansive celestial orbital atmosphere.

music_themes.title: Movement I: The Fragile Spark and the Shattered Island
music_themes.instrumentation: Solo wooden overtone flute, low contrabass drone, sparse pizzicato cello, erupting into brass clusters and tribal bronze war-horns.
music_themes.key_and_tempo: D minor | 68 BPM rising to 132 BPM during eruption
music_themes.dramatic_function: Establishes human vulnerability at the campfire before unleashing an apocalyptic, percussive tectonic explosion as Toba ruptures.

music_themes.title: Movement II: The Sulfuric Shroud and the Dying Light
music_themes.instrumentation: Chilled glass harmonica, muted violins in microtonal glissando, low bowed contrabass, and metallic Tibetan singing bowls.
music_themes.key_and_tempo: G minor modal | 54 BPM slow, funeral lament
music_themes.dramatic_function: Evokes the terrifying six-year darkness, freezing temperatures, and the slow starvation of terrestrial ecosystems.

music_themes.title: Movement III: The Eye of the Needle (The Two Thousand)
music_themes.instrumentation: Solo melancholic Armenian duduk, trembling cello solo, heartbeat frame drum (48 BPM), and warm acoustic harp accents.
music_themes.key_and_tempo: A minor | 52 BPM intimate, fragile pulse
music_themes.dramatic_function: Underscores the existential cliff of the 2,000-person bottleneck, turning into quiet curiosity upon discovering the fish in the shrinking river.

music_themes.title: Movement IV: Fire-Craft, The Bowstring, and the Sacred Exchange
music_themes.instrumentation: Rhythmic African clay udu drums, acoustic kora arpeggios, taut rising string ostinato, bursting into sweeping noble cellos and coastal ocean flutes.
music_themes.key_and_tempo: E minor resolving to E Dorian | 88 BPM kinetic, ascending to 104 BPM
music_themes.dramatic_function: Drives the technological leap of archery, builds heart-stopping suspense at the standoff, and resolves into noble tribal brotherhood.

music_themes.title: Movement V: The Blue Highway and the Eternal Kin
music_themes.instrumentation: Full cinematic orchestra: soaring warm French horns, triumphant violins, African choral harmonies in open fifths, settling on a solitary warm acoustic guitar and glowing cello.
music_themes.key_and_tempo: D major / B minor | 76 BPM uplifting and transcendent
music_themes.dramatic_function: Celebrates the diaspora of humanity out of Africa and concludes on profound ancestral kinship and catharsis.
